entries.title: Proverbs 13:1
segments: ¶A wise son [heeds] his father's instruction, But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:2
segments: ¶A man shall eat well by the fruit of [his] mouth, But the soul of the unfaithful feeds on violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:3
segments: ¶He who guards his mouth preserves his life, [But] he who opens wide his lips shall have destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:4
segments: ¶The soul of a lazy [man] desires, and [has] nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:5
segments: ¶A righteous [man] hates lying, But a wicked [man] is loathsome and comes to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:6
segments: ¶Righteousness guards [him whose] way is blameless, But wickedness overthrows the sinner.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:7
segments: ¶There is one who makes himself rich, yet [has] nothing; [And] one who makes himself poor, yet [has] great riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:8
segments: ¶The ransom of a man's life [is] his riches, But the poor does not hear rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:9
segments: ¶The light of the righteous rejoices, But the lamp of the wicked will be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:10
segments: ¶By pride comes nothing but strife, But with the well-advised [is] wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:11
segments: ¶Wealth [gained by] dishonesty will be diminished, But he who gathers by labor will increase.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:12
segments: ¶Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But [when] the desire comes, [it is] a tree of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:13
segments: ¶He who despises the word will be destroyed, But he who fears the commandment will be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:14
segments: ¶The law of the wise [is] a fountain of life, To turn [one] away from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:15
segments: ¶Good understanding gains favor, But the way of the unfaithful [is] hard.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:16
segments: ¶Every prudent [man] acts with knowledge, But a fool lays open [his] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:17
segments: ¶A wicked messenger falls into trouble, But a faithful ambassador [brings] health.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:18
segments: ¶Poverty and shame [will come] to him who disdains correction, But he who regards a rebuke will be honored.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:19
segments: ¶A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul, But [it is] an abomination to fools to depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:20
segments: ¶He who walks with wise [men] will be wise, But the companion of fools will be destroyed.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:21
segments: ¶Evil pursues sinners, But to the righteous, good shall be repaid.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:22
segments: ¶A good [man] leaves an inheritance to his children's children, But the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:23
segments: ¶Much food [is in] the fallow [ground] of the poor, And for lack of justice there is waste.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:24
segments: ¶He who spares his rod hates his son, But he who loves him disciplines him promptly.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:25
segments: ¶The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul, But the stomach of the wicked shall be in want.
